text.title: NIGHTSHIFT
text.subtitle: Every night from 2:00 to 3:00, the town has a second shift.
text.title_keys: Z choose   X back   arrows move   F11 fullscreen
text.new_confirm: Start over? Every night so far is forgotten.
text.hint_help: Do one step of their job. Slow, but makes a friend.
text.hint_hustle: Press {confirm} when the line is in the orange. Fast, but makes an enemy.
text.hint_stall: Wait it out. Hits this round do half.
text.hint_wick_light: Wick lights the arena. You can see everything this round.
text.hint_wick_hold: Wick blocks the first hit this round.
text.hint_wick_warm: Wick's flame warms you. Awake goes up.
text.hint_pockets: Use something from your pockets. It takes your turn.
text.todo_spare_finish: TODO(Tadzio): the real verbs for spare_option and finish_option.
text.wick_holds: Wick: I'll take the first one!
text.dark_warning: The lights are going out. Ask Wick!
text.rewind_prompt: Press {rewind} to wind the watch back!
text.lamps_forgotten_none: Nothing. The lamps kept it all.
text.lamps_rule: Only what you save at a lit lamp stays.
text.todo_path_names: TODO(Tadzio): the real names for the three paths.
text.reason_asleep: You fell asleep on the job.
text.board_keys: left / right to read   X to step back
